authority.rule: In any disagreement between this JSON and the governing document, the document governs and this JSON must be corrected to match.

queue_closed_note: The currently justified program is exhausted without manufacturing evidence — not that research is finished forever.

production_boundary.statement: Nothing in R0-R6 constitutes permission to alter frozen R4. The program generated diagnostics, rejections, falsifications, instrument characterizations, and data-dependency findings - not a new production specification. Any future R4 modification is a NEW strategy candidate under the frozen stage-boundary process, never an "improvement".
production_boundary.stage_boundary_rule: Every stage R0-R8: can_modify_r4 = false. Only a separate, explicitly approved promotion process ever turns research output into production strategy behavior.

FALSIFIED.definition: Evidence contradicts the preregistered hypothesis under the declared experiment.

INCONCLUSIVE.definition: The experiment did not generate sufficient evidence to decide the hypothesis.
INCONCLUSIVE.rule: INCONCLUSIVE is never read as a pass.

PARKED.definition: Further work under the current data/assumption class is not justified; reopening requires a MATERIAL change (new data class or new preregistered rationale).
PARKED.rule: PARKED is never read as falsified, and vice versa.

VALIDATED.note: No VALIDATED verdict exists in EigenCapital research; the best available research outcome is CANDIDATE within research only.

naming_disambiguation.frozen_r4: The frozen R4 production strategy (risk_conditioned_continuation) — also called production R4.
naming_disambiguation.stage_r4: Research stage R4 (mean reversion / stat-arb family) — also called R4-MR. Entirely distinct from the production strategy.

stages.name: Research Infrastructure Verification
stages.summary: Existing research machinery inspected against the frozen R0-R8 requirements; only demonstrable gaps patched.

stages.name: Monte Carlo Diagnostics
stages.key_finding: Dependence effect: IID resampling understates drawdown/streak/recovery tails vs block resampling.
artifacts: reports/r1_monte_carlo/ (trade stream TS-R4-D1-0001, evidence report JSON/MD)

stages.name: Alpha Factor Laboratory
stages.summary: Lab validated; first preregistered factor REJECTED (momentum_12_1 x r4_local_v1 x h=21: mean rank IC -0.0440, Holm p 0.4398, stress-cost spread negative).

stages.name: Parameter Stability
stages.key_finding: Frozen config OUTSIDE_STABLE_REGION (92% of 1,500 points fragile; PBO 1.000 across 16/16 partitions with non-independence caveat; DSR 0.0019 n.s.). Observed axis associations quarantined — acting on them requires a NEW preregistration.

stages.name: Mean Reversion / Statistical Arbitrage (R4-MR)
stages.summary: B1: 2 pairs, 1 trade. B2: 8-pair preregistered expansion, 5 trades < 20 -> parking rule fired. Gate starvation structural on daily bars. Reopening requires a new data class.
artifacts: reports/r4_mean_reversion/ (B1 + B2 reports, per-pair trade CSVs)

stages.name: Triple-Barrier Labeling
stages.key_finding: Instrument validated (1,311 events = TS-R4-D1-0001, 0 exclusions, byte-identical determinism, PIT proven by perturbation); overlap characterized (492 pairs, 663 events, mean uniqueness 0.837). NOT evidence of predictive power.
artifacts: reports/r5_triple_barrier/ (label run JSON/CSV/MD, per-event audit trail)

stages.name: Meta-Labeling
stages.summary: B1 design exercised end-to-end; preregistered filter vacuous (skip class empty: R4's upstream regime gate had already excluded the targeted states). B2 correctly not run. Supported claim is filter-specific, NOT "no feature can work".

stages.name: Order-Flow Entropy
stages.summary: Requires trade/order-flow data that does not exist locally; OHLC proxies banned.

stages.name: Strategy-Level Portfolio Construction
stages.summary: Requires >= 1 additional validated strategy family; none exists.

trial_slot_ledger.accounting_rule: One preregistration consumes one trial slot; the family is the unit of evidence where preregistered. No slot re-opened; no post-hoc filter/threshold shopping.

slots.subject: First preregistered factor: momentum_12_1 x r4_local_v1 x h=21
slots.evidence: Mean rank IC -0.0440; Holm p 0.4398; stress-cost spread negative.

slots.subject: H1: frozen config lies inside a stable parameter region
slots.evidence: Frozen config OUTSIDE_STABLE_REGION; 92% of 1,500 points fragile; PBO 1.000 (16/16 partitions, non-independence caveat); DSR 0.0019 n.s.

slots.subject: Two-pair mean-reversion family (AUDUSDm/NZDUSDm, EURUSDm/GBPUSDm)
slots.evidence: Gate starvation on daily bars; 1 trade total; missing evidence, never promoted to a pass.

slots.subject: 8-pair preregistered expansion under unchanged frozen pipeline
slots.evidence: Pre-committed parking rule fired: 5 trades < 20 across the family.

slots.subject: Triple-barrier label run on trade stream TS-R4-D1-0001
slots.evidence: 1,311 events, 0 exclusions, byte-identical determinism, PIT proven by perturbation; not evidence of predictive power.

slots.subject: Meta-labeling baseline with preregistered filter
slots.evidence: Filter vacuous (skip class empty — upstream regime gate had already excluded the targeted states); B2 correctly not run.

rules: New research starts with a NEW preregistration and fresh trial accounting — never by quietly extending R2-R6 (that would contaminate their records).
Parked stages reopen only via a materially different preregistered rationale or a new data class (intraday / order-flow for R4-MR and R7).
R8 requires at least one additional validated strategy family, which does not exist.
"The queue is closed" means the currently justified program is exhausted without manufacturing evidence — not that research is finished forever.

data_upgrade_contract.status: DRAFT contract — NOT a preregistration, opens no trial slots, authorizes no experiment.
